compared_values_and_defects_identified.detail: prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset used latest_published_broker_session (18:00 Taipei) for all FinMind connectors, but check_taiwan_refresh_preflight and verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback fell through to the 13:30 Taipei market-close cutoff for tw-finmind-monthly-revenue, tw-finmind-quarterly-statements, and tw-finmind-valuation.

FinMindTaiwanFundamentalsAdapter stamps metadata.date / normalized_row.date with the period-end date ('2026-10-31' month-end for tw_monthly_revenue, '2026-09-30' quarter-end for tw_financial_statement) while stamping metadata.as_of_date, metadata.ingest_job.run_date, and metadata.refresh_coverage.window_end with the trading session run_date ('2026-11-17'). Preflight and readback compared metadata.date ('2026-10-31') directly against the trading session date ('2026-11-17').

FinMindTaiwanFundamentalsAdapter stamps source_id with prefix 'finmind:<dataset>:' (e.g. 'finmind:tw_monthly_revenue:TWSE:2330:3cc25dbbec5d8679'), whereas preflight and readback required 'tw-official:<dataset>:'.

fix_applied.publication_rule: check_taiwan_refresh_preflight and verify_bounded_source_refresh_readback now use latest_published_broker_session (18:00 Taipei cutoff) for profile['base'] == 'tw-finmind-fundamentals', matching prepare_bounded_source_refresh_dataset.
fix_applied.same_kind_comparison: expected_finmind_fundamental_period_ends compares period-end against period-end for tw_monthly_revenue (month-end) and tw_financial_statement (quarter-end) and session against session for tw_valuation_bwibbu and metadata.as_of_date / ingest_job.run_date / refresh_coverage.window_end.
fix_applied.source_id_prefix: Preflight and readback accept 'finmind:<dataset>:' (as well as 'tw-official:<dataset>:') for profile['base'] == 'tw-finmind-fundamentals'.

verdicts_when_provider_session_newer_tha.published_early: provider_session > expected_session and provider_session is a trading session day <= latest closed Taipei date (today when now_t >= 13:30 Taipei, else yesterday) -> status='published_early', reason='published_early', is_failure=False
verdicts_when_provider_session_newer_tha.future_session: provider_session > latest closed Taipei date (after today's Taipei date, or today before 13:30 Taipei close) -> status='future_session', reason='future_session', is_failure=True
verdicts_when_provider_session_newer_tha.session_mismatch: provider_session is missing, malformed, or a non-session day (weekend/holiday) -> status='session_mismatch', reason='provider_session_mismatch', is_failure=True

failure_classes.cause: scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh line 7146 ran 'git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null' unconditionally even for PANTHEON_DEPLOY_COMPONENT=refresh-only. When the test suite was run from an isolated directory copy without a .git directory, every test invoking 'deploy_nonprod_vm.sh --refresh-only' exited 128 before execute_bounded_source_refresh_entrypoint started.
failure_classes.fix: Guarded 'git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null' in scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh with 'if [[ "${PANTHEON_DEPLOY_COMPONENT}" != refresh-only ]]; then', since refresh-only already validates -f "${PANTHEON_REMOTE_DIR}/docker-compose.yml" and does not use git.

failure_classes.cause: Test asserted 13 /readyz attempts (1 + 12 retries), whereas scripts/deploy_nonprod_vm.sh line 2821 uses 'curl_with_retry .../readyz 36 5' (37 attempts = 180s).
failure_classes.fix: Updated expected /readyz attempt count in test_exact_restore_readiness_timeout_prevents_success_and_next_connector to 37.

failure_classes.cause: Test set readiness_always_fails=True, which triggered the pre-preflight /readyz check before any container mutation (where --non-blocking exits 0) instead of testing post-restore /readyz failure.
